Rough size of the area, or just a guess

after_time: Who will sign the contract? Everyone on the deed should be at the estimate visit
Do you own the home or rent? (the owner must sign)
How is the attic or crawl space reached? Hatch, stairs, a tight space
Any roof leaks, stains or musty smells
Pets at home during the work
secure_page_only: Any special care needs at home during spray foam work
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property, or someone with the owner's written OK. A renter's job needs the owner to sign.

stop.words: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, a burning smell from the attic or a light, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: no booking; a new request must say the home was made safe

stop.words: a ceiling sagging or falling, soaked insulation hanging down
stop.says: Stay out of that room, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

go_on.words: water coming through a ceiling or soaking the attic
go_on.says: Shut off the water at the main valve if a pipe is leaking. Stay away from wet outlets, lights and switches. Call a roofer or a plumber first.

go_on.words: old loose-fill insulation that looks like gray-brown pebbles, or old cloth-covered wiring
go_on.says: Don't touch, sweep or vacuum it, and don't go into the attic. We'll test and check first.
go_on.booking: goes on; the lab test or an electrician's check becomes a first step

safety_and_stop_words.business_line: Questions about an old chimney, a gas appliance's venting or old wiring go to the business's own line

prep: Clear a path to the attic hatch and move boxes away from the hatch
Take down anything stored near the eaves or the attic floor
Keep pets and everyone else out of the work area
Put any lockbox code on the secure page
Spray foam jobs: plan to be out of the house for the time the maker says; the details are on the secure page

staff.licenses_or_certificates: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
staff.stand_in: Another crew lead may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its crew lead unless Sam moves it
staff.roles: Crew leads (Gil, Marta): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the crew. Energy advisors (Ines, Tomas) at the office.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property, or someone with the owner's written OK. A renter's job needs the owner to sign.
children_and_age.minors_texts: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Office: the code at the desk.
visit.done: The final depth and coverage check, then the walk-through, then DONE on the last work day; the care notes go with it
visit.changes_at_visit: A written change order, priced and signed by both, before any changed work. Wet insulation, a bath fan venting into the attic, old wiring or mold found are priced this way.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).

license.who: The business; plus a qualifying person where the state's form names one. Spray foam installers hold their own certification where the state's form asks. Asbestos removal is a separate licensed trade.

Any job-size limit the license has
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
